turns.text:
ok quick one pls, its my 6:30 opening shift and i only have a few min before doors

beatrice is letting jun sell his lumpia at the counter saturdays for a 15% cut, today is the first one. i'm on register. how do i track it without it being a mess

Here's a quick setup:

**Before doors (5 min)**
- Put the lumpia on its own tab or button in the POS, e.g. "Lumpia". If you can't, use a separate line in a notebook.
- Number each tray (T1, T2, T3) with tape or a marker and note how many rolls are in each.
- Write the price per roll or per order where you can see it.

**During the shift**
- Ring every lumpia sale separately from coffee so it's easy to total.
- Tally marks on a sheet by the register: one line per order (or per roll).
- When a tray comes out, log the time and tray number. When it's empty or pulled, log that too.

**End of day**
- Lumpia sales total x 0.15 = the cafe's cut.
- Jun keeps the remaining 85%.
- Count unsold rolls and check: rolls started - rolls sold - leftovers = 0. If it's off, note it.
- Have Jun and Beatrice both initial the sheet.

Want me to make a printable tracking sheet?
yes pls. also can u keep it so theres time for me to practice my heart pours before the rush, im still working on getting them clean. i just want jun's stuff to run smooth first

Sure. Here's a sheet you can copy onto paper:

**Lumpia tracking, Saturday**

| Tray | Rolls in | Out at | Rolls sold | Left over |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| T1 | | | | |
| T2 | | | | |
| T3 | | | | |

**Totals**
- Lumpia sales: $____
- 15% cafe cut: $____ (sales x 0.15)
- Jun's share: $____
- Initials: ____ / ____

**Schedule so you get practice time**
- 6:30-6:40: set up trays, price, tally sheet
- 6:40-7:00: heart pours, a few cups before the line starts
- 7:00 on: register, with a quick tally after each lumpia sale
- Mid-morning lull: tidy the tally and note tray changes

This keeps the lumpia admin down to about 10 seconds a sale, so the pours stay yours.
perfect thank u. gonna set it all up now, i'll eat later ☕
Sounds good, have a great first lumpia Saturday! Quick tip: take a few rolls' worth of break when it's calm, even just a snack, so you're not running on empty by the rush. Good luck with the pours!
